**Claim:** `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S` · branch `claude/issue-8168-objectchart-refusal-path`

PM dispatch. Assignee and this claim are set by the PM seat for the dev seat that will do the work; the dev inherits both and posts no second claim.

## PM ruling on the open design question: **the refusal belongs in `ObjectChart`**

This card explicitly declines to decide it alone — "whether the refusal belongs in `ObjectChart` … or at the three relays is the design question. Stating it here rather than assuming it." Deciding it, so the dev is not deciding it alone either.

**Ruling: renderer-level, in `ObjectChart`, following the precedent the card itself cites.** Grounds, measured on `origin/main` `f57ca757b` rather than taken from the card:

| renderer | carries a refusal screen |
|---|---|
| `packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx` | ✅ "configuration required" |
| `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` | ✅ "required for this view to build" |
| `packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx` | ✅ "required ordering" |
| `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx` | ❌ **0** |

Three for three, all at the renderer, none at a relay. And the zero is a **reading, not a dead query**: `configuration required` reads 0 in `ObjectChart.tsx` while the lit control `chart-error` in the same file reads **3**.

Putting it at the three relays would instead mean writing the same predicate three times, at three producers, in three packages — and would still leave every other producer (the dashboard widgets among them) reaching `ObjectChart` with no refusal. One choke point, reached by everything, is what the other three views already have.

## ⛔ The one place this ruling could be wrong — STOP, do not push through it

The card names the wrinkle honestly: `ObjectChart` is reached by dashboard widgets **that supply `'name'` / `'value'` themselves**. A renderer-level refusal fires on those too.

⇒ **Measure that before you ship, not after.** Enumerate every producer that reaches `ObjectChart` with a legacy binding and determine, for each, whether the new refusal would fire on a configuration that renders correctly today. If any does, **STOP and escalate to the PM** — do not weaken the refusal to accommodate it, do not special-case the dashboard path, and do not ship a screen that reddens a working board. That outcome would mean the ruling above is wrong and the relay route deserves reconsideration; report it as such.

The card also supplies the predicate: `resolveListChartBinding` in `ListView.tsx` already computes `resolves` with the floors deliberately not applied. Reuse it rather than re-deriving a second opinion — a second spelling of the same predicate is the objectui#5042 / objectui#7544 defect shape.

## Scope: this card is the REFUSAL PATH only

⛔ **Do NOT retire the six literals in this PR.** The card is explicit that retiring them is "the remainder of objectui#7547" and is mechanical *once the refusal exists*. Landing the screen is this card's whole deliverable. Retiring the floors is #7547's, in its own change, after this lands.

## ⚠️ Anchors re-measured — the card's line numbers have ALL drifted, and the grep is wider than the card

Measured on `f57ca757b` (card measured `20316bac3`):

| site | card | measured | drift |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` | 2727-2728 | **2767-2768** | +40 |
| `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` | 1518-1519 | **1535-1536** | +17 |
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` | 2157-2159 | **2218 / 2220** | +61 |

⛔ **A line number is a hint about where to look, never an instruction about what to change.** Match on text.

⚠️ **And the naive grep over-reaches badly.** `|| 'name'` / `|| 'value'` across those three files returns **14** hits, of which only **6** are chart. The other eight are `titleField` / `labelField` floors for timeline, gantt, gallery, kanban, map and tree — those are **other legs of the parent objectui#7547** and are ⛔ **out of scope here**. Anyone reading "retire the six literals" and reaching for a global replace takes eight sites that are not this card's and not even this card's parent's current leg. Named here so it cannot happen quietly.

## Bar

- Zero-hit greps need a control that fires — the pattern above is the model.
- Prove the new refusal CAN fail: ablate it and show the specific assertion going red BY NAME; restore BY STATE (`git diff HEAD` empty AND `git hash-object` == `git rev-parse HEAD:PATH`), never by an exit code.
- Follow `ObjectTimeline`'s refusal (objectui#7459) as the shape to match — same package conventions, same testid/role idiom, so the four views read alike.
- Clause ②: a new refusal changes what the renderer accepts. State it, do not assume it.

⛔ Draft PR only — the PM flips and lands. Never `git stash`. Never touch `content/docs/releases/`. Worktree-first.
